Cats purr for a variety of reasons beyond simple contentment. They purr when happy, but also when stressed, injured, or even giving birth. This behaviour comes from a cat's maternal and social instincts. Mother cats teach kittens to hunt by bringing them prey. No — cats have one life, just like other mammals. Kneading — the rhythmic push-pull motion cats make with their front paws — starts in kittenhood when kittens knead their mother's belly to stimulate milk flow.
